description: This file defines and manages optional bundled clusters for the openclaw project, including a list of cluster names, environment-based inclusion logic, and utility functions to determine installation and build requirements.

methods.name: isOptionalBundledCluster
methods.description: Checks if a given cluster is present in the optional bundled cluster set.

methods.name: shouldIncludeOptionalBundledClusters
methods.description: Determines whether optional bundled clusters should be included based on environment variable settings.

methods.name: hasReleasedBundledInstall
methods.description: Checks if a package JSON indicates a released installation of an openclaw bundled cluster.

methods.name: shouldBuildBundledCluster
methods.description: Decides whether to build a specific cluster based on release status, environment, and options.
